Why Lovart is the Ultimate AI Poster Creator
Nano Banana Typography
Most AI models fail at spelling. Nano Banana is optimized for design, rendering clear, legible text on your posters so you don't have to fix it in Photoshop later.
Layered Editing
Lovart's exclusive 'Edit Elements' capability allows you to 'explode' a generated image into layers. Move the main subject, resize the logo, or change the background independently.
Smart Composition
The Design Agent understands 'Negative Space.' It generates layouts that leave room for your headlines and copy, rather than cluttering the entire image.
One-Click Upscaling
Need to print A3 or A2? Use our AI Upscaler to boost your poster resolution to 4K or 8K without losing quality or introducing artifacts.
Instant Mockups
Present your work professionally. Apply your generated poster to various 3D mockups directly within the workflow to see how it looks in context.
Vector Style Support
Create flat, vector-style illustrations that are perfect for branding and easy to convert for large-scale printing formats.

A Complete Poster Workflow: From Prompt to Mockup
Ideate with Agent

Don't just prompt; collaborate. Tell the Lovart Design Agent your goal, and it will reason through the layout, suggesting the best composition and utilizing the Nano Banana model for superior text accuracy.
Edit Elements & Text
Unlike static AI images, Lovart lets you tweak the details. Use 'Edit Elements' to separate layers and move objects, or use 'Edit Text' to fix typos and change fonts directly on the canvas.
Mockup & Export
See your design in the real world before you print. Use our built-in Mockup tool to visualize your poster on a street billboard or a framed wall, then export in high-res for printing.

Can Lovart actually spell text on posters correctly?

Yes! Our Nano Banana model is specifically optimized for typography. While no AI is perfect 100% of the time, Nano Banana is industry-leading in rendering accurate text. Plus, you can use our 'Edit Text' tool to correct any specific letters.
How does 'Edit Elements' help with poster design?

Traditional AI images are flat. Lovart's 'Edit Elements' identifies layers in your generated image, allowing you to move, resize, or delete specific objects (like a character or logo) to perfect the composition for printing.
Is the resolution high enough for printing?
Absolutely. You can use our integrated AI Upscaler to increase the resolution of your poster to 4K or higher, ensuring crisp details for standard print sizes like A3, A2, or 24x36 inches.
Can I visualize how the poster looks in real life?
Yes, Lovart includes a 'Mockup' feature. Once you generate your poster, you can instantly apply it to various templates (bus stops, walls, frames) to see a realistic preview.
Do I own the rights to the posters I create?
Yes, users with a paid subscription have full commercial rights to the assets they create using Lovart's Design Agent.
